resources.string: Bring in the SET_UP folder from the disc of your own copy of the game (the folder with SCRIPT.LPK, PIC.LPK and the other files).
Mining is off (optional: bring in the mining.txt of your mining server below)

Saves without a sound every %1$d lines and when you leave the app, into a slot of its own that the game\'s menus do not show. The game then starts at that line, past the title menu. Your saves and quick saves stay as they are.
Option 1: connect this device to a computer with a cable, allow file transfer, and copy the SET_UP folder into %1$s on the device.

Option 2: have the folder on this device first (in Downloads, on a memory card, on a USB stick), then import it with the button below. The app makes its own copy, so the original can be deleted afterwards.
Copying %1$s: %2$s of %3$s. Keep the app open.
A folder named %1$s is already in the app. Replace it with the one you chose?
The folder was copied, but there is no SCRIPT.LPK in it. Choose the game\'s SET_UP folder.
The chosen file could not be read.
The chosen file is not a mining.txt. Download it from your mining server\'s settings.
Remove mining.txt? The game then sends no lines until you bring one in again.
Controls: tap = left button · tap with two fingers or back = right button (menu) · swipe up or down = wheel (history) · long press = skip.
A mouse, a keyboard or a game controller works too, as on the PC.
